name: Growth round
summary: A full round: caps first, then the reply pass on every platform, one original each, and the close.

nodes.title: Round starts
nodes.body:
- Open a checklist: `python scripts/run.py start --recipe round`.
- Each step ends done with evidence, or skipped with a reason.

nodes.title: Caps and pacing
nodes.body:
- `python playbook/audit.py today` against the caps in flow pacing.
- A platform at its cap gets replies only.

nodes.title: Which pass?
nodes.body:
- **replies:** everyone waiting, on every platform.
- **originals:** one per platform, from the post bank.

nodes.title: Close the round
nodes.sub: Every item logged, the run finished
nodes.body:
- `python scripts/run.py finish` refuses while a step is open.
- Its list of skips, pace flags and QC warnings goes in the report.

nodes.title: Audit log
nodes.sub: Log and verify what went out
